tasks.title: Lecture #57
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk on an archaeology podcast.
tasks.transcript: Man: Throughout the years, archaeologists have discovered many fascinating artifacts on the Greek island of Crete. One example is the Phaistos disc, an ancient clay artifact that was found in the ruins of the Minoan palace at Phaistos. The Minoan civilization lasted from about 3100 BCE to 1100 BCE, and we think this artifact was made in the second millennium BCE. It was discovered in 1908 and it features many stamped symbols, 241 to be exact, in the shape of a spiral. The symbols, they include images of things like animals, tools, and so on. These animals, tools, and other images form a pattern in the shape of a spiral. What's so interesting is that these symbols are unlike anything else from the Minoan civilization or any other known writing system. Many experts have tried to decipher these enigmatic symbols. Some suggest they could represent an unknown language. Others think they might represent a calendar or even a religious hymn, yet no consensus has been reached. Another intriguing thing about the Five Stars disc is the method used to imprint the symbols. This involved pressing prefabricated stamps into wet clay. This process is really remarkable. It suggests a level of sophistication similar to early printing. Some scholars hypothesize that the disc might be an import from another culture, a lone artifact brought to Crete by traders or travelers. But this is another point of contention surrounding this fascinating artifact.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention animals and tools?

options.A: To explain the content of the stamps on the Phaistos Disc
options.B: To emphasize the difficulty of locating the Phaistos Disc
options.C: To identify goods that the Minoans frequently traded
options.D: To identify artifacts that were found near the Phaistos Disc

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目的意思是：演讲者为什么提到动物和工具？ 选项分析： A. To explain the content of the stamps on the Phaistos Disc. 演讲者提到动物和工具是为了具体描述圆盘上印章符号的形状和内容，说明这些符号描绘了什么东西，符合题意。原文定位句： “The symbols, they include images of things like animals, tools, and so on.” B. To emphasize the difficulty of locating the Phaistos Disc. 文中未提及寻找难度。 C. To identify goods that the Minoans frequently traded. 文中提到贸易是指圆盘可能是商人带来的，而非指这些动物和工具是贸易货物。 D. To identify artifacts that were found near the Phaistos Disc. 这些是圆盘上的符号图案，不是旁边发现的文物。

questions.stem: What does the speaker say about the purpose of the symbols on the Phaistos Disc?

options.B: It remains a subject of disagreement.
options.C: It was not discovered until recently.
options.D: It was determined by a team of archaeologists.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目的意思是：关于费斯托斯圆盘上符号的用途，演讲者说了什么？ 选项分析： A. It was most likely religious. 文中提到宗教赞美诗只是猜测之一，并未确认。 B. It remains a subject of disagreement. 演讲者列举了语言、日历、赞美诗等多种猜测，最后总结说 “no consensus has been reached”（尚未达成共识），即存在分歧，符合题意。原文定位句： “Some suggest they could represent… Others think… yet no consensus has been reached.” C. It was not discovered until recently. 文中未提及发现用途的时间。 D. It was determined by a team of archaeologists. 既然没有共识，就说明尚未确定。

questions.stem: What impressed the speaker about the production of the Phaistos Disc?

options.A: It was different from any other early printing method.
options.B: It involved a large group of people working together.
options.C: It involved a material not found in other artifacts.
options.D: It probably required the use of an advanced technique.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目的意思是：费斯托斯圆盘的制作工艺让演讲者印象深刻的是什么？ 选项分析： A. It was different from any other early printing method. 原文明确说是 “similar to early printing”（类似于早期印刷），选项A说“不同于”，与原文矛盾，故错误。 B. It involved a large group of people working together. 文中未提及参与人数。 C. It involved a material not found in other artifacts. 文中提到的是粘土，这是常见材料。 D. It probably required the use of an advanced technique. 演讲者称赞这种冲压工艺 “really remarkable”（真的很了不起），并指出它显示了 “a level of sophistication”（精密/精细的水平），这暗示了当时使用了先进的技术，符合题意。原文定位句： “This process is really remarkable. It suggests a level of sophistication similar to early printing.”

questions.stem: What possibility about the Phaistos Disc does the speaker mention at the end of the talk?

options.A: That it was used as a form of money
options.B: That it was a typical artifact among ancient ruins
options.C: That it originated outside of Crete
options.D: That it was created by an earlier civilization than the Minoans

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目的意思是：演讲者在最后提到了关于费斯托斯圆盘的哪种可能性？ 选项分析： A. That it was used as a form of money. 未提及货币功能。 B. That it was a typical artifact among ancient ruins. 文中提到它是 “a lone artifact”（孤品），说明它并不典型。 C. That it originated outside of Crete. 演讲者最后提到学者假设它可能是 “an import from another culture”（来自另一种文化的进口品），即起源于克里特岛之外，符合题意。原文定位句： “Some scholars hypothesize that the disc might be an import from another culture…” D. That it was created by an earlier civilization than the Minoans. 文中说是由商人或旅行者带到克里特岛，并未断定是由比米诺斯更早的文明创造的。
